title: Photoswitchable imaging contrast agents as an emerging frontier in precision bioimaging
content:
Chem. Soc. Rev., 2026, 55,2959-2993
DOI: 10.1039/D6CS00003G, Review Article
Open Access

Xiaoqiong Tan, Qiankun Ni, Ting Luo, Ki Taek Nam, Hong-Bo Cheng, Paul J. Dyson, Xing-Jie Liang, Juyoung Yoon
This review summarizes recent advances in photoswitchable imaging contrast agents (PICAs), with a focus on molecular design and assembly strategies to improve their imaging quality and precision across diverse bioimaging modalities.
